financial_history.notes: 2026Q1 is the first quarter consolidating Calpine, roughly doubling revenue and breaking comparability. Q2 2026 reports 6 Aug 2026. FCF line is GAAP operating cash flow minus capex and differs sharply from the company's adjusted FCF presentation.

benchmarks.source_note: S&P 500 aggregates from FactSet Earnings Insight (31 Jul 2026 PDF + 3 Aug 2026 commentary). Percentile ladders are MIXED BASIS — see basis field on each.

sp500.distortion_note: Q2 2026 headline earnings growth is inflated by non-operating mark-to-market gains on equity investments at Amazon (~$53.4bn, Anthropic stake) and Alphabet ($98.0bn). Ex those two names growth is 28.8% and index net margin is 14.4%. Use the ex- figures for operating-quality comparison.

rev_growth.basis: TRUE cross-sectional percentiles — Mauboussin & Callahan, The Base Rate Book (Credit Suisse, Sep 2016), top-1000 global companies 1950-2015, 3-year CAGR, INFLATION-ADJUSTED (real). Add ~2-3pp for a nominal comparison. The current cycle runs far hotter — the S&P 500 aggregate is 14.1% nominal.

op_margin.basis: INDUSTRY-LEVEL percentiles, not company-level — computed across 80 Damodaran/NYU Stern US industry aggregates ex-financials and real estate (Jan 2026, 5,994 US firms). True company-level dispersion is wider, so the real P90 is likely higher and P25 lower.

fcf_margin.basis: DERIVED PROXY, not a published series: EBITDA margin x (1 - 21% tax) - net capex/sales per industry, from Damodaran Jan 2026 datasets, percentiled across the same 80 industries. Ignores working capital, stock comp and interest. Indicative only.

sector_op_margin.note: Damodaran/NYU Stern industry aggregates, Jan 2026 — use these to normalise across sectors. A 65% operating margin means something very different in semis vs mining.

base_rates.note: What actually counts as exceptional, from published research.
base_rates.detail: Mauboussin: 11.9% of 3-year windows delivered >20% real revenue CAGR. McKinsey (top 5,000 global, 2005-2019): median company grew 2.8%/yr; only 1 in 8 exceeded 10%/yr; only 1 in 3 top-quartile growers stayed top-quartile the following 5 years. Damodaran (Feb 2026): only 29% of global firms earn a return on equity above their cost of equity — roughly seven in ten listed companies destroy value. Verdad (1996-2022): gross margin is the most persistent profitability metric, but the top quintile mean-reverts most.

leverage.note: S&P Global Ratings indicative debt/EBITDA thresholds for standard-volatility corporates (criteria published 18 Sep 2012, still governing).
leverage.detail: Conservative below ~2.0x; investment-grade normal 2-3x; stretched above 4x; >5x is high-yield territory. Regulated utilities, REITs and telecoms run structurally higher against contracted cash flows.
